summary: Every new statement I could test is mathematically sound, but the file's headline description asserts a dichotomy ("encloses exactly one of the two sides") that its own new lemma refutes, and overstates what the PR leaves open. One hypothesis (`hSK`) is redundant and its redundancy propagates into a consumer hypothesis that makes a documented API comparison false as written.
